verdict.rationale: Codegen agents create branches, commit code, and open PRs, and can review/comment on PRs (codegen-docs-4, codegen-docs-20), implying a diff exists before merge, but there's no explicit evidence of a review-and-approve gate where a developer inspects agent changes before a PR is created — PR creation appears automatic once the agent finishes. missing for 10: explicit pre-PR diff review/approval workflow, documentation of a staging step where changes are held for developer sign-off before PR creation, independent confirmation of this gate in practice.
